title: Text Has Curvature
abstract: arXiv:2602.13418v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Does natural language text have an intrinsic curvature? Language is increasingly modeled in curved geometries - hyperbolic spaces for hierarchy, mixed-curvature manifolds for compositional structure - yet a basic scientific question remains unresolved: what does curvature mean for text itself, in a way that is native to language rather than an artifact of the embedding space we choose? We argue that text does indeed have curvature, and show how to detect it, define it, and use it. To this end, we propose Texture, a text-native, word-level discrete curvature signal, and make three contributions. translated_abstract: 自然语言文本是否具有内在曲率？语言越来越多地被建模在弯曲几何中——用双曲空间表示层级结构，用混合曲率流形表示组合结构——然而一个基础科学问题仍未解决：曲率对文本本身而言意味着什么，并且这种意义是语言原生的，而非我们所选择的嵌入空间所带来的人为产物？我们认为文本确实具有曲率，并展示了如何检测、定义和使用它。为此，我们提出了Texture，一种文本原生的、词级离散曲率信号，并做出了三项贡献：（a）存在性：我们提供了实证和理论证明，表明自然语料库中的语义推断是非平坦的；（b）定义：我们将Texture定义为上下文中词信念场的带符号双轴曲率——即前缀与后缀之间调和作用的微分——通过去偏的薛定谔传输散度来度量（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出Texture——一种文本原生、词级的离散曲率信号，通过实证和理论证明自然语言文本确实具有内在曲率，并给出了该曲率的定义与检测方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Texture, a text-native word-level discrete curvature signal, providing empirical and theoretical evidence that natural language text has intrinsic curvature, along with its definition and detection method.
